script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Aman International se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — main dekh raha tha ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 8,692 din se, lekin last 30 days mein ek bhi enquiry nahi aayi aur aapne platform pe koi bhi active day nahi liya — toh seedha baat karna chahta tha.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, jab se aapne IndiaMART join kiya, kya kabhi leads aaye the jo kaam ke lage, ya start se hi lagaa ki platform se kuch connect nahi ho raha — matlab setup ke time koi issue tha ya expectation kuch aur thi?
script_parts.value_demo: Dekho ji, ek honest baat — Guwahati mein abhi demand tier 'Red' hai, matlab is category mein buyers ki activity bahut limited hai, aur aapka Catalog Quality Score sirf 10 hai jo ki critical range mein hai — iska matlab buyers search karte hain toh aapki listing unhe dikh hi nahi rahi, toh leads ka sawaal baad mein aata hai.
script_parts.action: Toh abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka account open karta hoon aur hum saath milke sirf 2-3 products ki listing properly set karte hain, sahi keywords, sahi category, image — taaki CQS score thoda upar aaye aur aapki visibility shuru ho.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, koi pressure nahi hai — bas itna batao ki kya aap abhi 10 minute de sakte hain listing fix karne ke liye, aur agar iske baad bhi leads nahi aate toh hum honestly next step discuss karenge?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Aman International? I'm calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your account is quite old, around 8,692 days, but in the last 30 days there have been zero enquiries and zero active days on the platform, so I wanted to have a direct conversation about this.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to understand — since you joined IndiaMART, did leads ever come in that felt useful, or has it felt disconnected from the start? Was there a setup issue at the beginning, or was there an expectation mismatch about how the platform works?
script_parts_en.value_demo: To be honest with you, Guwahati currently falls in the 'Red' demand tier for your category, meaning buyer activity is very limited in this geography, and on top of that your Catalog Quality Score is only 10, which is in the critical range — this means even the few buyers who are searching simply cannot find your listing.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your account and we'll fix 2-3 product listings together: right keywords, correct category, and image — so your CQS score improves and your visibility actually starts.
script_parts_en.close: No pressure at all — just let me know if you can spare 10 minutes right now to fix the listings, and if leads still don't come after that, we'll have an honest conversation about what makes sense next.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
